article.headline: Los Angeles plays San Antonio, looks to end road slide
article.description: Los Angeles Clippers (4-9, 13th in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (12-3, second in the Western Conference)
article.title: Los Angeles plays San Antonio, looks to end road slide
article.linkText: Los Angeles plays San Antonio, looks to end road slide
article.story: Los Angeles Clippers (4-9, 13th in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (12-3, second in the Western Conference) San Antonio; Thursday, 8 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles travels to San Antonio looking to stop its five-game road skid. The Spurs have gone 11-2 against Western Conference opponents. San Antonio ranks second in the Western Conference with 54.0 points per game in the paint led by Victor Wembanyama averaging 15.2. The Clippers are 3-7 in Western Conference play. Los Angeles gives up 117.7 points to opponents while being outscored by 5.8 points per game. The Spurs average 117.1 points per game, 0.6 fewer points than the 117.7 the Clippers give up. The Clippers average 6.0 more points per game (111.9) than the Spurs allow (105.9). TOP PERFORMERS: Wembanyama is averaging 28.4 points, 12 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 4.1 blocks for the Spurs. Dylan Harper is averaging 19.0 points over the last 10 games. Brook Lopez is scoring 14.1 points per game and averaging 5.3 rebounds for the Clippers. Darius Garland is averaging 2.1 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Spurs: 9-1, averaging 117.3 points, 49.8 rebounds, 27.6 assists, 7.5 steals and 7.1 blocks per game while shooting 46.7% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 103.8 points per game. Clippers: 3-7, averaging 111.6 points, 39.1 rebounds, 26.5 assists, 8.6 steals and 4.6 blocks per game while shooting 45.5% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 120.1 points. INJURIES: Spurs: Dylan Harper: day to day (undisclosed), Jayden Quaintance: out (knee), Tobias Harris: day to day (calf). Clippers: Yanic Konan Niederhauser: out (lisfranc), Jordan Miller: out (shoulder), Brandon Ingram: out (heel), Bradley Beal: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
